memo_delta.stage_one_comment: Emaar stays under observation through the standing Watchlist replacement. The original Starter Position Only publication remains frozen for audit, but its owner-cap application and gain-only bear scenario were already defective at decision time. The latest DFM close is 11.46 dirhams, a 6.07% price decline from the frozen 12.20-dirham anchor; a verified matching benchmark total return is unavailable. The second-quarter EPS beat prediction failed, while first-half revenue and pretax profit still grew. Those findings must travel together: a consensus miss does not establish that backlog conversion collapsed. The masterplan capital schedule, Sukuk redemption evidence and Egyptian subsidiary outcome remain unresolved in this review. Do not add based on the old upside target. Obtain the primary quarterly results and financing disclosures, refresh the earnings setup, and test the replacement governance and capital-discipline conditions before reconsidering entry.
